sloka: तच्छूलं परमक्रुद्धो मध्ये जग्राह वीर्यवान् ।अनेकैः समरे शूरै राक्षसैः परिवारितः ।। ६.१०४.१३ ।।
transliteration: tacchūlaṁ paramakruddho madhye jagrāha vīryavān ।anekaiḥ samare śūrai rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ ।। 6.104.13 ।।

translations.english: In the battlefield surrounded by Rakshasa heroes, enraged valiant Ravana took up the trident holding it in the middle.
